notes.title: Mary Update 1
notes.content:
[h3]Bugs Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Restart button on Chapter 3's death screen not working
[*] Not all story texts appear in Chapter 2 (even if not required to progress)
[*] Footstep sound for "Detective Finn" in Chapter 1 missing
[*] Pressing Space after the Chapter 2 intro dialogue still plays the dialogue sound
[*] Enemies clipping into objects they shouldn't
[*] Restarting from the death screen returns to the chapter's start
[/list]

[h3]Fixes / Additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shadows on 'Ultra' graphics changed to a less detailed, more realistic version
[*] Story texts in Chapter 2 adjusted (size and position)
[*] Along with fixing footstep sounds, the sound was replaced
[*] Easter eggs added
[*] Graphics improved
[*] Optimization improved for Medium and Low graphics settings (the game now runs better on lower-end PCs with Medium or Low graphics)

[h5]Main Instructions Updated:[/h5]
[list]
[*] "MOVE: WASD" changed to "INTERACT: E"
[*] "LOOK AROUND USING MOUSE" changed to "DON'T FORGET YOUR CLIPBOARD (ALT)"
[*] "ANALYZE CLUES CAREFULLY" added
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Mary News!
notes.content:
Only 11 days left until Mary's release!

Until then, I have some news:
- Soundtracks available on Steam:
 Shortly after Mary's release, the soundtracks used in the game will be made available on Steam.
- Small launch announcement:
 It will be displayed shortly before the game's starting point.

notes.title: MARY IS "DONE"
notes.content:
Mary is already in the final stage of development, a stage known as GAME JUICE: which is basically a stage in which we polish the game, improve the graphics, add sound effects (Mary there are few sound effects), and things that no one He notices when they are there. But when it doesn't exist, everyone complains.
Get ready for the release of Mary on December 20, 2024 and a launch short film, just before the release of the full game. The price of the game will be $9.99

notes.title: TROCA DE CLASSIFICAÇÃO INDICATIVA!
notes.content:
We are currently at the beginning of the development of chapter 3, which is a chapter that the story will weigh a little more on, both psychologically and visually. Therefore, we had to redo the Steam content questionnaire to make sure that the indicative rating would remain [b]12+[/b]. However, that's not what happened. Chapter 3 will portray themes of revenge, suicide and violence, so the rating increased from [b]12+[/b] to [b]16+[/b].
But minors of this age can normally play chapters 1 and 2.

It's good to make it clear that it may YES be delayed, but this is the date we plan to release the game.
